versions.changelog: Set the official skill homepage to https://ecomagenttools.com.

- Added .clawhubignore file to the project.
- Removed skill-card.md file from the project.
- SKILL.md updated to include OpenClaw metadata, add YAML frontmatter, and clarify the skill description.
- No major functional or algorithmic changes; documentation and metadata improvements only.

SEO Evaluator v2.1 introduces a rigorous, evidence-first approach to evaluating ecommerce and local HTML pages for SEO.

- Separates findings into five distinct evidence labels: VERIFIED, LIKELY, EDITORIAL, UNAVAILABLE, and APPENDIX.
- Provides detailed, step-based prompts for assessing ecommerce SEO, with explicit boundaries for each evidence type.
- Prohibits invention of data, universal scoring, or speculative advice beyond observable facts and supplied context.
- Establishes new calibration guardrails to prevent overreach and maintain objective, reproducible evaluations.
- Expands evaluative areas to cover SERP inputs, content and intent, internal linking, rendering effects, structured data, internationalization, performance signals, and more.
